summary: Markets are bracing for the Federal Reserve’s interest rate decision tomorrow, and it seems investors want to hear that central bankers will act decisively to bring down inflation. The Nasdaq Composite ended the day down 0.8%. In addition to a down day in markets, the 10-year U.S. Treasury yield briefly flirted with 5% again today before settling at 4.995%—the highest level since July 2007.
